text:
Liz: quick sync — we should add a preview endpoint that returns per-route impact estimates before apply. low friction for product teams.
Tom: agree. sketch: GET /v1/configs/{id}/preview?cohort=10&include_routes=true returns diff + routeCounts + est_qps + est_cost_delta.
Ravi: please make sure preview runs the actual routing substitutions (tenant->route mapping) so numbers are accurate. not just top-level keys.
Kasey: UX: console should show a small "preview" flyout with three columns: Diff, Top affected routes, Risk signals.
Liz: risk signals = estimated p99 change, error delta %, cost delta, and whether feature toggles change model type (fp16 -> int8) which requires runtime pool change.
Tom: telemetry: emit counter `config_preview_requests_total{cohort="10%",result="ok|error"}` and gauge `config_preview_est_cost_delta_cents`. also record `config_preview_routes_count`.
SRE: watch label explosion. cohort shouldn't be a label; use cohort_bucket like "small|medium|full". and avoid raw snapshot_id as a metric label.
Ravi: good call. we'll include snapshot_id only in traces/logs. metrics will have snapshot_hash (short) if needed.
Kasey: product ask: preview should include a confidence band for estimates. e.g. est_cost_delta +/- 10%. helps teams decide whether to A/B.
Liz: also add a flag for preview that runs simulations with prefix-cache warming on/off. Preview should show both.
Tom: API shape: POST /v1/configs/{id}/preview with body {"cohort":10,"simulate_cache":true,"signal_set":["p99","err_rate","cost"]} response is {"diff":"...","metrics":[{"name":"p99","baseline":...}]}
Ravi: prefer response as flattened text for console consumption. but we keep structured JSON in the API. console will render.
Kasey: when preview shows risk > threshold, console shows a "recommend staged rollout" CTA with suggested cohorts (1%, 10%, 25%).
Liz: ops: what about guardrails? if an apply would increase p99 by > 1% or error-rate by > 0.3% we block and create incident draft for ops review.
Tom: implement block in the apply service: Evaluate preview impact for target cohort 100%, compare to thresholds, then return 409 with reason "guardrail: p99_up".
SRE: ensure apply is idempotent. repeated apply attempts should be rate-limited — 3 attempts/hr per snapshot triggers an alert.
Ravi: logging: emit structured event `cfg_preview` and `cfg_apply` with fields: snapshot_hash, initiator, target_cohort, previewed_metrics (comma list), blocked_reason.
Liz: sample log lines: `cfg_preview snapshot_hash=5f3a initiator=liz cohort=10 routes=27 est_cost_delta_cents=120 preview_ok=true`
Kasey: also request we show historical previews in console per config, so teams can see how estimates changed over time.
Tom: storage wise we store preview results for 7 days by default, longer if requested (archive).
Liz: on override workflow: self-serve force is disabled. ops can run `POST /v1/configs/{id}/apply` with {"force":true,"run_by":"ops","ticket":"INC-1234","reason":"customer-blocker"}. must be tied to an audit entry.
SRE: audit log must contain trace_id and link to preview that was used at decision time.
Ravi: can we add a dry-run apply mode that does the side effects (cache prefetch) but not route switch? label it `apply?mode=dry_prefetch`. useful for warming.
Kasey: love that. console should expose "Warm caches and preview" separate action from full apply.
Tom: timeline: API + basic telemetry by Tue, preview storage and console UI by next sprint.
Liz: risks: cost calc needs accurate pricing per model variant. Alex on pricing is OOO; Tom can fake MSRP for now.
Ravi: I'll wire preview to routing engine in sandbox only at first (no production apply).
Liz: ops-bot please create ticket PREV-912 with the guardrail thresholds and owners.
ops-bot: created PREV-912 and assigned to @Liz, @Tom, @SRE https://tickets/redwood/PREV-912
Kasey: small ask: preview API should accept `route_regex` to limit scope for manual spot checks.
Tom: ok. we'll add `route_filter` param.
SRE: final: avoid high-cardinality in metrics; prefer rollups and sample traces for deep-dive.
Liz: great. next actions: Tom builds API proto + telemetry, Ravi hooks routing substitutions in sandbox, Kasey drafts console mock, SRE verifies metric schema. follow-up in PREV-912.
